# ColorPicker { #anylumino.ColorPicker }

```python
ColorPicker(
    value='black',
    description='',
    concise=False,
    disabled=False,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

Color picker control.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

value : optional
    Initial value and synced Python value.
description : optional
    Label shown next to the control.
concise : optional
    Whether to use a compact color-picker display.
disabled : optional
    Whether user interaction is disabled.
layout : optional
    ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing.
style : optional
    ipywidgets style object or style dictionary.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [concise](#anylumino.ColorPicker.concise) | Display short version with just a color selector. |
| [disabled](#anylumino.ColorPicker.disabled) | Enable or disable user changes. |
| [value](#anylumino.ColorPicker.value) | The color value. |
